title: Mondaine Swiss Railway Clock
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: Swiss railway dial study with a 58-second sweep, two-second hold, and discrete minute/hour advance.

learningObjectives: Analyze the sequence of sweep, hold, and coupled minute/hour advance using playback controls.

keyQuestions: When do the black hands advance?
Why must the second hand complete its circuit in less than sixty seconds?
